authority: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
checks: site-specific LIDAR surveys have been carried out across England since 1998
data is distributed as GeoTIFF rasters in 5km zip files
vertical reference is Ordnance Survey Newlyn
data is aligned to the OS Grid
vertical accuracy is plus or minus 15cm RMSE
the coordinate transformation used is specific to the survey time period
metadata records survey date for a location
metadata records product resolution for a location
metadata records transformation and geoidal model for a location
the dataset provides an OSGM02-to-OSGM15 adjustment grid for legacy-height harmonisation
